name: DCA Cocina Cucamonga Grilled Pollo Asado / Carne Asada Tacos & Rice (No Onion/Lime Mod)
brandOrRestaurant: Cocina Cucamonga Mexican Grill (San Fransokyo Square · Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: Ordering the grilled chicken (Pollo Asado) or steak (Carne Asada) tacos plain with rice—without raw onions, cilantro, radish, salsa, or lime juice—gives you a gluten-free protein meal.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Pollo Asado or Kids' Chicken Taco with rice only—ask for no beans, no raw onion/cilantro, no tomatillo salsa, and do not squeeze the lime wedge.
watchOuts: Discard the lime wedge (citrus trigger) and skip the spicy red/green salsas and street corn
